title: Provide a way to modify volume of all devices
line: You can now bind keys, including the volume keys, to change the volume of every output device at once.
explanation: The volume key actions in plasma-pa's kded module only change the preferred output device, and there was no other action that touched the rest, so people with several output devices in use had to adjust each one separately. The change adds two global shortcut actions, "Increase Volume of All Output Devices" and "Decrease Volume of All Output Devices", with no default keys. Each one moves every real output device by the configured volume step (relative, clamped as usual) and shows the OSD for the preferred device.

commits.message:
kded: add shortcuts to change the volume of all output devices

The volume keys only ever change the preferred output device, so people
with several devices in use at once have to adjust each one by hand. Add
"Increase/Decrease Volume of All Output Devices" actions without keys.

BUG: 372016

media.caption: Master: after pressing Volume Up twice, only the default device (Speakers) went from 50% to 60%; Headphones stayed at 50%.
With the fix and Volume Up bound to the new action: the same two presses raise both Speakers and Headphones to 60%.
Master: the Audio Volume shortcuts only have per-default-device volume actions.
With the fix: new "Increase/Decrease Volume of All Output Devices" actions, here with Volume Up reassigned to the increase one.
